title: salix humboldtiana var. oxyphylla
intro: Salix humboldtiana var. oxyphylla, commonly known as a type of willow, is a plant species that belongs to the Salicaceae family. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antipyretic properties, making it effective in treating various conditions such as fever, pain, and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Salix humboldtiana var. oxyphylla are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including salicin, a glycoside that exhibits analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects. However, the detailed bioactive constituents of this plant are not extensively documented, but it is known to contain salicin and other phenolic compounds.
